items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: we went to Europe in '58 with Sam

ctx.x: This was after the show, because we went to Europe in '58 with Sam, and then we came back and took another show -- another show down in Miami that year, in '58 too, which didn't last very long, with Cab Calloway.
Now, you were -- was this the first time you went to Europe?
